_readme: National House result used to grade the generic-ballot tracker. Hand-entered; update when the Clerk of the House publishes official statistics, then set status to "final". national_margin is Dem − Rep in points.
margin_note: Press reports put the Democratic national House vote lead at about 14 points; raw vote totals still differ between sources and are not final.

sources.label: Cook Political Report, 2026 House results by the numbers
